verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report confirms Gitea has a built-in mirror feature that keeps local copies of followed upstream projects, which is inbound pull mirroring from another Git server. No first-party documentation in the pack describes mirroring. The Gogs migration mention is a one-time migration, not ongoing sync, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented push mirroring to another server, branch-level mirroring, first-party mirror docs (sync intervals, auth), and broader independent corroboration.
